$comment: Social media on the phone (D-074, core/Social.cpp). Posts are World state: an author (a character, or the anonymous gossip account), a time, text, maybe a place and tagged people, and what it's about (the memory or rumour it came from). Characters a script plays post from what really happened to them: a moment is one of their own memories of a type listed under auto.moments (or a check-in when they walk into a place of a listed type), posted after a delay with the chance base + per_trait x trait/100 times the moment's chance, at most per_day a day and min_gap_minutes apart, in their voice (the first voice whose minimums their personality meets; 'default' lines are the fallback). Lines may use {first} (the author), {place}, {with} (the other person), {title}, {pet}, {item}; a line whose placeholders can't be filled isn't used. People post with the post op. The gossip account posts what people witnessed, from the rumours the World keeps: once at least min_heard people know and delay_minutes have passed, with the kind's chance, at most per_day a day; twist_chance of its posts aren't what happened, and only the people who were there can tell. It is run by whoever holds the secret run_by_secret (Sienna, in her data). Likes and new followers add fame (at most fame.max_per_day a day per person) and move the author's side of the relationship by these small amounts. Notifications reach a person at most notify.per_hour an hour, and at most notify.game_per_day a day of them come from the game (a post the game wrote that tags you, the gossip account); the rest wait in the app's activity list. In the morning (until last_night.shown_until_hour) the feed opens with Last night in Livéra: the most liked and commented public posts from from_hour last night to to_hour this morning, and the gossip account's.
